question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

Unit of weight for precious stones
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Unit of weight for precious stones"** refers to the measurement used for weighing gems like diamonds. (कीमती पत्थरों के वजन की इकाई) • **Example: **The diamond was measured to be 2 carats. • **"Carat"** is a **unit of weight used for precious stones** and pearls, equivalent to 200 milligrams. (कैरेट) • **Example: **The jeweler confirmed that the gemstone was a 1-carat sapphire. • Hence, we can infer that the word for** "Unit of weight for precious stones" **is **"Carat"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Pure** (शुद्ध): Free from any contamination or impurities. • **Example:** The water from the mountain stream is pure and clean. • **Reliable** (विश्वसनीय): Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted. • **Example:** He is a reliable friend who always supports me. • **Accurate** (सटीक): Correct in all details; exact. • **Example:** The scientist provided an accurate measurement of the chemical compound. 136:Tbea,
